title: Deterministic credit scoring stub over age, income and credit history flags

scope_out: must not call an external credit bureau or any live provider; must not introduce randomness, wall-clock time or request order into the score; must not read a threshold from anywhere but the application's pinned policy version

entities.name: Deterministic credit scoring stub over age, income and credit history flags

operations.text:
1. Add a private, deterministic age-band and income-band bucketing helper (pure, no I/O) in `backend/src/service/origination/scoring.py` (new).
2. Add a private deterministic adjustment over the sorted `credit_history_flags` — a stable hash, no `random` module and no wall-clock read — in `backend/src/service/origination/scoring.py`.
3. Define the public `score(applicant: Applicant) -> int` in `backend/src/service/origination/scoring.py`, composing the age/income buckets and the credit-history adjustment into one deterministic Credit Score, importing `Applicant` from `backend/src/types/origination.py` (owned by E4-S1, existing type; no new type is added here).
4. Add determinism (AC1), credit-history-flag-sensitivity (AC2) and no-outbound-collaborator (AC3) tests in `backend/tests/unit/test_scoring_stub.py` (new), covering AC1-AC3.
